---
title: "Measurements project - site script (DLMM export)"
output: html_document
---

<!--
MEASUREMENTS PROJECT - SITE SCRIPT
What it does at each site:
  1. Loads the analytic file from the cohort pipeline (same file as 01_analysis_rr.Rmd).
  2. Builds the measurements cohort: IMV >= 24 h, not a neuro ICU, no continuous or push NMBA in the first 48 h.
  3. Writes Table 1 (by ICU type), a missingness summary and the cohort cleaning summary.
  4. Builds one design matrix and exports the DLMM aggregates for the three continuous outcomes
     (28-day ventilator-, ICU- and hospital-free days). The pooled linear mixed model is reconstructed
     centrally (pda / DLMM) - these are the federated results.
  5. Fits the site-level models for all six outcomes (continuous + trach, in-hospital death, reintubation):
     primary = random intercept for ICU (Nakagawa R2), sensitivity = fixed effect for ICU (R2 / McFadden
     pseudo-R2). These are reported per site and are not meta-analyzed.
Everything written for upload goes to output/FINAL_DATA_UPLOAD_ME/measurements_project/.
Do not edit section 3 (shared specification) locally: the coordinating site checks that every site's export
was built with identical settings.
-->

# 1. Setup
```{r setup}
packages <- c("data.table", "arrow", "yaml", "rprojroot", "MASS", "lme4", "performance")
install_if_missing <- function(package) {
  if (!requireNamespace(package, quietly = TRUE)) install.packages(package, dependencies = TRUE)
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(package, character.only = TRUE))
}
invisible(lapply(packages, install_if_missing))

# ---- Paths (same config as the rest of the project) --------------------------
project_root <- file.path(
  find_root(rprojroot::has_dir("language_preference_deep_sedation_rr")),
  "language_preference_deep_sedation_rr"
)
config_dir <- file.path(project_root, "config")
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = config_dir)
config_file <- c(file.path(config_dir, "language_sedation_config.yaml"),
                 file.path(config_dir, "language_sedation_config.yml"))
config_file <- config_file[file.exists(config_file)]
if (length(config_file) == 0) stop("No config file found (.yaml or .yml)")
config <- yaml::read_yaml(config_file[1])

data_dir         <- config$data_dir
local_dir        <- config$local_dir
institution      <- config$institution
time_zone        <- config$time_zone

output_dir       <- file.path(local_dir, "output")
intermediate_dir <- file.path(local_dir, "intermediate_data_DO_NOT_UPLOAD")
final_data_dir   <- file.path(output_dir, "FINAL_DATA_UPLOAD_ME")

measurements_project    <- file.path(final_data_dir, "measurements_project")
measurements_tables_dir <- file.path(measurements_project, "final_tables")   # Table 1, cleaning summary, table1 log
measurements_final_data <- file.path(measurements_project, "final_data")     # missingness summary
measurements_dlmm_dir   <- file.path(measurements_final_data, "dlmm")        # DLMM export (.rds)
measurements_model_data <- file.path(measurements_final_data, "model_data")  # site-level model coefficient files

for (d in c(intermediate_dir, measurements_project, measurements_tables_dir, measurements_final_data, measurements_dlmm_dir,
            measurements_model_data))
  dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

min_cell <- 10                                                     # small-cell rule for shared counts
censor_n <- function(n) ifelse(n > 0 & n < min_cell, paste0("<", min_cell), as.character(n))
current_project <- "measurements"
```

# 2. Load the analytic file
```{r load-data}
read_table_any <- function(path) {
  if (grepl("\\.parquet$", path)) return(as.data.table(arrow::read_parquet(path)))
  if (grepl("\\.fst$", path))     return(as.data.table(fst::read_fst(path)))
  fread(path)
}
analytic_path <- file.path(intermediate_dir, paste0("analytic_file", institution, ".parquet"))
if (!file.exists(analytic_path)) stop("Analytic file not found: ", analytic_path, " - run the cohort pipeline first")
total_cohort <- read_table_any(analytic_path)
setDT(total_cohort)
message("Analytic file: ", analytic_path, " (modified ", format(file.info(analytic_path)$mtime), ")")

# Patients carried forward only for the R&R ICU-timing sensitivity analysis are NOT part of the cohort
if ("sens_only_icu_late" %in% names(total_cohort)) {
  n_icu_late <- total_cohort[sens_only_icu_late %in% TRUE, .N]
  total_cohort <- total_cohort[!(sens_only_icu_late %in% TRUE)]
  message(n_icu_late, " ICU-timing sensitivity rows removed")
}
n_final_cohort <- nrow(total_cohort)

# Columns this script needs (new-pipeline names; old names are mapped in meas_prepare)
meas_required <- c("hospitalization_id", "hospital_id", "hospital_icu_id", "icu_imv", "run_hrs",
                   "continuous_nmba_48", "push_paralytics", "language_category",
                   "race_category", "age_category", "sex_category", "ethnicity_category_final", "bmi",
                   "elixhauser_score", "laps2", "observation_year",
                   "vent_free_days_28_alt", "icu_free_days_28_alt", "hospital_free_days_28_alt",
                   "percent_deep_sedation_48", "deep_sedation_count_total_48", "median_rass_cont",
                   "median_rass_binary", "rass_weighted_avg", "deep_sedation_weighted", "sedation_index_score")
old_names <- c(run_hrs = "imv_duration_hours_final",
               time_from_begin_obs_to_icu_hours = "time_from_begin_imv_to_icu_hours")
missing_cols <- meas_required[!meas_required %in% names(total_cohort) &
                              !(meas_required %in% names(old_names) & old_names[meas_required] %in% names(total_cohort))]
if (length(missing_cols)) stop("Not in the analytic file: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "),
                               " - check Part Twelve's analytic_cols")
if ("reintubation_final" %in% names(total_cohort) && !"reintubation" %in% names(total_cohort))
  setnames(total_cohort, "reintubation_final", "reintubation")
miss_bin <- setdiff(c("trached", "death_during_admission", "reintubation"), names(total_cohort))
if (length(miss_bin)) message("Binary outcomes not in the analytic file (their site-level models are skipped): ",
                              paste(miss_bin, collapse = ", "))
if (!any(c("intubation_site", "location_of_intubation_adj", "location_of_intubation") %in% names(total_cohort)))
  stop("Not in the analytic file: intubation_site (or location_of_intubation_adj)")
if (!"time_from_begin_obs_to_icu_hours" %in% names(total_cohort) &&
    !"time_from_begin_imv_to_icu_hours" %in% names(total_cohort))
  stop("Not in the analytic file: time_from_begin_obs_to_icu_hours")
```

# 3. Table 1 functions (same as 01_analysis_rr.Rmd; cell-level suppression, Nov 16)
```{r table1-functions}
make_table1_federated <- function(dt, cat_vars = NULL, cont_vars = NULL, by = NULL, site_name = NA_character_) {
  dt <- as.data.table(copy(dt))
  out_list <- list()

  if (!is.null(cat_vars) && length(cat_vars) > 0) {
    for (v in cat_vars) {
      if (!is.null(by)) {
        tmp <- dt[, .(n = .N), by = c(by, v)]
        totals <- dt[, .(N = .N), by = by]
        tmp <- merge(tmp, totals, by = by, all.x = TRUE)
        setnames(tmp, old = by, new = "group")
        setnames(tmp, old = v, new = "level")
        tmp[, `:=`(site = site_name, variable = v, variable_type = "categorical",
                   level = as.character(level), pct = 100 * n / N,
                   mean = NA_real_, sd = NA_real_, median = NA_real_, p25 = NA_real_, p75 = NA_real_)]
      } else {
        tmp <- dt[, .(n = .N), by = v]
        total_n <- nrow(dt)
        setnames(tmp, old = v, new = "level")
        tmp[, `:=`(site = site_name, group = "overall", variable = v, variable_type = "categorical",
                   level = as.character(level), N = total_n, pct = 100 * n / N,
                   mean = NA_real_, sd = NA_real_, median = NA_real_, p25 = NA_real_, p75 = NA_real_)]
      }
      tmp <- tmp[, .(site, group, variable, variable_type, level, n, N, pct, mean, sd, median, p25, p75)]
      out_list[[paste0("cat_", v)]] <- tmp
    }
  }

  if (!is.null(cont_vars) && length(cont_vars) > 0) {
    for (v in cont_vars) {
      if (!is.null(by)) {
        tmp <- dt[, .(
          n = sum(!is.na(get(v))), N = .N, pct = NA_real_,
          mean   = as.numeric(if (all(is.na(get(v)))) NA_real_ else mean(get(v), na.rm = TRUE)),
          sd     = as.numeric(if (sum(!is.na(get(v))) <= 1) NA_real_ else sd(get(v), na.rm = TRUE)),
          median = as.numeric(if (all(is.na(get(v)))) NA_real_ else median(get(v), na.rm = TRUE)),
          p25    = as.numeric(if (all(is.na(get(v)))) NA_real_ else quantile(get(v), 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)),
          p75    = as.numeric(if (all(is.na(get(v)))) NA_real_ else quantile(get(v), 0.75, na.rm = TRUE))
        ), by = by]
        setnames(tmp, old = by, new = "group")
        tmp[, `:=`(site = site_name, variable = v, variable_type = "continuous", level = NA_character_)]
      } else {
        tmp <- dt[, .(
          n = sum(!is.na(get(v))), N = .N, pct = NA_real_,
          mean   = as.numeric(if (all(is.na(get(v)))) NA_real_ else mean(get(v), na.rm = TRUE)),
          sd     = as.numeric(if (sum(!is.na(get(v))) <= 1) NA_real_ else sd(get(v), na.rm = TRUE)),
          median = as.numeric(if (all(is.na(get(v)))) NA_real_ else median(get(v), na.rm = TRUE)),
          p25    = as.numeric(if (all(is.na(get(v)))) NA_real_ else quantile(get(v), 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)),
          p75    = as.numeric(if (all(is.na(get(v)))) NA_real_ else quantile(get(v), 0.75, na.rm = TRUE))
        )]
        tmp[, `:=`(site = site_name, group = "overall", variable = v, variable_type = "continuous", level = NA_character_)]
      }
      tmp <- tmp[, .(site, group, variable, variable_type, level, n, N, pct, mean, sd, median, p25, p75)]
      out_list[[paste0("cont_", v)]] <- tmp
    }
  }

  out <- rbindlist(out_list, fill = TRUE, use.names = TRUE)
  setcolorder(out, c("site", "group", "variable", "variable_type", "level", "n", "N", "pct", "mean", "sd", "median", "p25", "p75"))

  # Censoring (R&R: cell-level). Counts of 1-9 are hidden as "<10"; N stays on every row. Where exactly ONE cell of a
  # variable x group is hidden, the smallest other cell is hidden too ("suppressed") so it can't be recovered from N.
  out[, n_censored := NA_character_]
  cat_i <- out$variable_type == "categorical"
  out[cat_i, n_censored := fifelse(n < 10, "<10", as.character(n))]
  if (any(cat_i)) {
    out[cat_i, n_hidden := sum(n_censored == "<10"), by = .(variable, group)]
    sec <- out[cat_i & n_hidden == 1 & n_censored != "<10"][order(n)][, .SD[1], by = .(variable, group)]
    if (nrow(sec)) out[sec, on = .(variable, group, level), n_censored := "suppressed"]
    out[, n_hidden := NULL]
  }
  out[cat_i & n_censored %in% c("<10", "suppressed"), `:=`(n = NA_real_, pct = NA_real_)]
  out[variable_type == "continuous", n_censored := ifelse(!is.na(n) & n < 10, "<10", as.character(n))]
  suppressed_cont_vars <- out[variable_type == "continuous" & n_censored == "<10", unique(variable)]
  if (length(suppressed_cont_vars) > 0) {
    out[variable_type == "continuous" & variable %in% suppressed_cont_vars,
        `:=`(mean = NA_real_, sd = NA_real_, median = NA_real_, p25 = NA_real_, p75 = NA_real_,
             n_censored = ifelse(n_censored == "<10", "<10", "suppressed"), n = NA_real_)]
  }

  return(out[])
}

make_table1_comparisons <- function(dt, by, cont_vars = NULL, cat_vars = NULL,
                                    site_name = NA_character_, group_levels = NULL,
                                    reference_level = NULL, fisher_if_expected_lt5 = TRUE) {
  dt <- as.data.table(copy(dt))
  if (!(by %in% names(dt))) stop(sprintf("Grouping variable '%s' not found in dt.", by))
  dt <- dt[!is.na(get(by))]
  dt[, (by) := as.character(get(by))]

  observed_groups <- unique(dt[[by]])
  observed_groups <- observed_groups[!is.na(observed_groups)]

  if (!is.null(reference_level)) {
    if (!reference_level %in% observed_groups) stop(sprintf("reference_level '%s' not found in data.", reference_level))
    ref <- reference_level
    comparators <- if (!is.null(group_levels)) group_levels[group_levels != ref] else sort(observed_groups[observed_groups != ref])
  } else {
    if (!is.null(group_levels)) {
      if (length(group_levels) != 2) stop("group_levels must have length 2.")
      ref <- group_levels[1]; comparators <- group_levels[2]
    } else {
      if (length(observed_groups) != 2) stop(sprintf("Found %s groups — supply reference_level for 3+ groups.", paste(observed_groups, collapse = ", ")))
      grps <- sort(observed_groups); ref <- grps[1]; comparators <- grps[2]
    }
  }

  calc_multilevel_smd <- function(x, group, g1, g2) {
    dsub <- data.table(x = as.character(x), group = as.character(group))
    dsub <- dsub[!is.na(group) & group %in% c(g1, g2)]
    dsub[is.na(x), x := "missing"]
    levs <- sort(unique(dsub$x))
    if (length(levs) < 2) return(list(smd = NA_real_, smd_se = NA_real_))
    ref_lev <- levs[1]; keep_levs <- levs[levs != ref_lev]
    make_indicator_matrix <- function(vals, levels_keep) {
      out <- sapply(levels_keep, function(lv) as.numeric(vals == lv))
      if (is.null(dim(out))) { out <- matrix(out, ncol = 1); colnames(out) <- levels_keep }
      out
    }
    x1 <- dsub[group == g1, x]; x2 <- dsub[group == g2, x]
    n1 <- length(x1); n2 <- length(x2)
    if (n1 < 2 || n2 < 2) return(list(smd = NA_real_, smd_se = NA_real_))
    M1 <- make_indicator_matrix(x1, keep_levs); M2 <- make_indicator_matrix(x2, keep_levs)
    p1 <- colMeans(M1); p2 <- colMeans(M2); d <- p2 - p1
    S1 <- stats::cov(M1); S2 <- stats::cov(M2)
    if (is.null(dim(S1))) S1 <- matrix(S1, nrow = 1, ncol = 1)
    if (is.null(dim(S2))) S2 <- matrix(S2, nrow = 1, ncol = 1)
    S_pooled <- (S1 + S2) / 2
    S_inv <- try(solve(S_pooled), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(S_inv, "try-error")) {
      if (!requireNamespace("MASS", quietly = TRUE)) return(list(smd = NA_real_, smd_se = NA_real_))
      S_inv <- try(MASS::ginv(S_pooled), silent = TRUE)
      if (inherits(S_inv, "try-error")) return(list(smd = NA_real_, smd_se = NA_real_))
    }
    smd_val <- as.numeric(sqrt(t(d) %*% S_inv %*% d))
    # Yang & Dalton (2012) variance approximation for multivariate SMD
    k <- length(keep_levs)
    smd_se_val <- sqrt((n1 + n2) / (n1 * n2) * k + smd_val^2 / (2 * (n1 + n2)))
    list(smd = smd_val, smd_se = smd_se_val)
  }

  compare_continuous <- function(x, group, var_name, g1, g2, comparison_label) {
    dsub <- data.table(x = x, group = group)
    dsub <- dsub[!is.na(group)]
    x1 <- dsub[group == g1, x]; x2 <- dsub[group == g2, x]
    x1_nonmiss <- x1[!is.na(x1)]; x2_nonmiss <- x2[!is.na(x2)]
    n1 <- length(x1_nonmiss); n2 <- length(x2_nonmiss)
    mean1 <- if (n1 > 0) mean(x1_nonmiss) else NA_real_
    mean2 <- if (n2 > 0) mean(x2_nonmiss) else NA_real_
    sd1   <- if (n1 > 1) sd(x1_nonmiss) else NA_real_
    sd2   <- if (n2 > 1) sd(x2_nonmiss) else NA_real_
    med1  <- if (n1 > 0) median(x1_nonmiss) else NA_real_
    med2  <- if (n2 > 0) median(x2_nonmiss) else NA_real_
    p25_1 <- if (n1 > 0) as.numeric(quantile(x1_nonmiss, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)) else NA_real_
    p25_2 <- if (n2 > 0) as.numeric(quantile(x2_nonmiss, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)) else NA_real_
    p75_1 <- if (n1 > 0) as.numeric(quantile(x1_nonmiss, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)) else NA_real_
    p75_2 <- if (n2 > 0) as.numeric(quantile(x2_nonmiss, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)) else NA_real_

    estimate <- NA_real_; ci_lower <- NA_real_; ci_upper <- NA_real_; p_value <- NA_real_; test_used <- NA_character_
    if (n1 >= 2 && n2 >= 2) {
      tt <- try(t.test(x2_nonmiss, x1_nonmiss), silent = TRUE)
      if (!inherits(tt, "try-error")) {
        estimate <- unname(mean2 - mean1); ci_lower <- unname(tt$conf.int[1]); ci_upper <- unname(tt$conf.int[2])
        p_value <- tt$p.value; test_used <- "welch_t_test"
      }
    }
    pooled_sd <- NA_real_; smd <- NA_real_; smd_se <- NA_real_
    if (n1 >= 2 && n2 >= 2 && !is.na(sd1) && !is.na(sd2)) {
      pooled_sd <- sqrt(((n1 - 1) * sd1^2 + (n2 - 1) * sd2^2) / (n1 + n2 - 2))
      if (!is.na(pooled_sd) && pooled_sd > 0) {
        smd <- (mean2 - mean1) / pooled_sd
        smd_se <- sqrt((n1 + n2) / (n1 * n2) + smd^2 / (2 * (n1 + n2)))  # Hedges large-sample SE
      }
    }
    data.table(
      site = site_name, variable = var_name, variable_type = "continuous",
      comparison = comparison_label, level = NA_character_,
      group1 = g1, group2 = g2, group1_n = n1, group2_n = n2,
      group1_mean = mean1, group2_mean = mean2, group1_sd = sd1, group2_sd = sd2,
      group1_median = med1, group2_median = med2, group1_p25 = p25_1, group2_p25 = p25_2,
      group1_p75 = p75_1, group2_p75 = p75_2,
      statistic = "mean_difference", estimate = estimate, ci_lower = ci_lower, ci_upper = ci_upper, p_value = p_value,
      smd = smd, smd_se = smd_se, effect_measure = "mean_difference", test = test_used, note = NA_character_
    )
  }

  compare_categorical <- function(x, group, var_name, g1, g2, comparison_label) {
    dsub <- data.table(x = x, group = group)
    dsub <- dsub[!is.na(group)]
    dsub[, x := as.character(x)]
    dsub[is.na(x), x := "missing"]

    tab <- table(dsub$x, dsub$group)
    needed_cols <- c(g1, g2)
    if (!all(needed_cols %in% colnames(tab))) {
      full_tab <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(tab), ncol = 2, dimnames = list(rownames(tab), needed_cols))
      common_cols <- intersect(colnames(tab), needed_cols)
      full_tab[, common_cols] <- tab[, common_cols, drop = FALSE]
      tab <- full_tab
    } else {
      tab <- tab[, needed_cols, drop = FALSE]
    }

    n_levels <- nrow(tab)
    n1 <- sum(tab[, g1]); n2 <- sum(tab[, g2])
    overall_smd_result <- calc_multilevel_smd(dsub$x, dsub$group, g1, g2)
    overall_smd <- overall_smd_result$smd; overall_smd_se <- overall_smd_result$smd_se

    p_value <- NA_real_; test_used <- NA_character_
    if (n_levels >= 1) {
      chisq_try <- try(chisq.test(tab, correct = FALSE), silent = TRUE)
      if (!inherits(chisq_try, "try-error")) {
        expected <- chisq_try$expected
        if (fisher_if_expected_lt5 && any(expected < 5)) {
          fisher_try <- try(fisher.test(tab), silent = TRUE)
          if (!inherits(fisher_try, "try-error")) { p_value <- fisher_try$p.value; test_used <- "fisher_exact" }
          else { p_value <- chisq_try$p.value; test_used <- "chi_square" }
        } else { p_value <- chisq_try$p.value; test_used <- "chi_square" }
      }
    }

    out <- data.table(
      site = site_name, variable = var_name, variable_type = "categorical",
      comparison = comparison_label, level = NA_character_,
      group1 = g1, group2 = g2, group1_n = n1, group2_n = n2,
      group1_mean = NA_real_, group2_mean = NA_real_, group1_sd = NA_real_, group2_sd = NA_real_,
      group1_median = NA_real_, group2_median = NA_real_, group1_p25 = NA_real_, group2_p25 = NA_real_,
      group1_p75 = NA_real_, group2_p75 = NA_real_,
      statistic = "overall_difference", estimate = NA_real_, ci_lower = NA_real_, ci_upper = NA_real_, p_value = p_value,
      smd = overall_smd, smd_se = overall_smd_se, effect_measure = "categorical_smd", test = test_used, note = NA_character_
    )

    if (n_levels == 2) {
      levels_x <- rownames(tab); ref_level <- levels_x[1]; target_level <- levels_x[2]
      a <- as.numeric(tab[target_level, g2]); b <- as.numeric(tab[ref_level, g2])
      c <- as.numeric(tab[target_level, g1]); d <- as.numeric(tab[ref_level, g1])
      p1 <- if ((c + d) > 0) c / (c + d) else NA_real_
      p2 <- if ((a + b) > 0) a / (a + b) else NA_real_
      rd <- if (!is.na(p1) && !is.na(p2)) p2 - p1 else NA_real_
      rd_se <- if (!is.na(p1) && !is.na(p2) && (c + d) > 0 && (a + b) > 0)
        sqrt((p1 * (1 - p1) / (c + d)) + (p2 * (1 - p2) / (a + b))) else NA_real_
      rd_lcl <- if (!is.na(rd_se)) rd - 1.96 * rd_se else NA_real_
      rd_ucl <- if (!is.na(rd_se)) rd + 1.96 * rd_se else NA_real_
      pooled_p <- if (!is.na(p1) && !is.na(p2)) (p1 + p2) / 2 else NA_real_
      smd_binary <- if (!is.na(pooled_p) && pooled_p > 0 && pooled_p < 1) (p2 - p1) / sqrt(pooled_p * (1 - pooled_p)) else NA_real_
      n1_bin <- c + d; n2_bin <- a + b
      smd_binary_se <- if (!is.na(smd_binary) && n1_bin > 1 && n2_bin > 1)
        sqrt((n1_bin + n2_bin) / (n1_bin * n2_bin) + smd_binary^2 / (2 * (n1_bin + n2_bin))) else NA_real_

      out_rd <- data.table(
        site = site_name, variable = var_name, variable_type = "categorical",
        comparison = comparison_label, level = target_level,
        group1 = g1, group2 = g2, group1_n = n1, group2_n = n2,
        group1_mean = p1, group2_mean = p2, group1_sd = NA_real_, group2_sd = NA_real_,
        group1_median = NA_real_, group2_median = NA_real_, group1_p25 = NA_real_, group2_p25 = NA_real_,
        group1_p75 = NA_real_, group2_p75 = NA_real_,
        statistic = "risk_difference", estimate = rd, ci_lower = rd_lcl, ci_upper = rd_ucl, p_value = p_value,
        smd = smd_binary, smd_se = smd_binary_se, effect_measure = "risk_difference", test = test_used,
        note = sprintf("Binary categorical variable. level='%s' treated as event.", target_level)
      )
      out <- rbind(out, out_rd, fill = TRUE)
    } else if (n_levels > 2) {
      out[, note := "Multi-level categorical variable: overall p-value and omnibus SMD reported; CI not populated."]
    }
    out
  }

  all_comparisons <- lapply(comparators, function(comp) {
    g1 <- ref; g2 <- comp
    comparison_label <- paste0(by, ": ", g2, " vs ", g1)
    dt_pair <- dt[get(by) %in% c(g1, g2)]
    out_list <- list()
    if (!is.null(cont_vars)) {
      for (v in cont_vars) {
        if (!(v %in% names(dt_pair))) { warning(sprintf("'%s' not found. Skipping.", v)); next }
        out_list[[paste0("cont_", v)]] <- compare_continuous(dt_pair[[v]], dt_pair[[by]], v, g1, g2, comparison_label)
      }
    }
    if (!is.null(cat_vars)) {
      for (v in cat_vars) {
        if (!(v %in% names(dt_pair))) { warning(sprintf("'%s' not found. Skipping.", v)); next }
        out_list[[paste0("cat_", v)]] <- compare_categorical(dt_pair[[v]], dt_pair[[by]], v, g1, g2, comparison_label)
      }
    }
    rbindlist(out_list, fill = TRUE, use.names = TRUE)
  })
  out <- rbindlist(all_comparisons, fill = TRUE, use.names = TRUE)

  # Censoring
  out[, group1_n_censored := ifelse(group1_n < 10, "<10", as.character(group1_n))]
  out[, group2_n_censored := ifelse(group2_n < 10, "<10", as.character(group2_n))]
  out[group1_n < 10 | group2_n < 10,
      `:=`(estimate = NA_real_, ci_lower = NA_real_, ci_upper = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_,
           smd = NA_real_, smd_se = NA_real_, group1_mean = NA_real_, group2_mean = NA_real_,
           group1_sd = NA_real_, group2_sd = NA_real_, group1_median = NA_real_, group2_median = NA_real_,
           group1_p25 = NA_real_, group2_p25 = NA_real_, group1_p75 = NA_real_, group2_p75 = NA_real_,
           note = "Suppressed: cell size < 10")]
  out[group1_n < 10, group1_n := NA_real_]
  out[group2_n < 10, group2_n := NA_real_]

  # Complementary suppression across comparisons for the same variable
  suppressed_vars <- out[group1_n_censored == "<10" | group2_n_censored == "<10", unique(variable)]
  if (length(suppressed_vars) > 0) {
    out[variable %in% suppressed_vars,
        `:=`(estimate = NA_real_, ci_lower = NA_real_, ci_upper = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_, smd = NA_real_,
             group1_mean = NA_real_, group2_mean = NA_real_, group1_sd = NA_real_, group2_sd = NA_real_,
             group1_median = NA_real_, group2_median = NA_real_, group1_p25 = NA_real_, group2_p25 = NA_real_,
             group1_p75 = NA_real_, group2_p75 = NA_real_,
             group1_n_censored = ifelse(group1_n_censored == "<10", "<10", "suppressed"),
             group2_n_censored = ifelse(group2_n_censored == "<10", "<10", "suppressed"),
             group1_n = NA_real_, group2_n = NA_real_,
             note = ifelse(is.na(note) | note == "", "Suppressed: complementary cell size < 10", note))]
  }

  desired_order <- c("site", "variable", "variable_type", "comparison", "level",
                     "group1", "group2", "group1_n", "group1_n_censored", "group2_n", "group2_n_censored",
                     "group1_mean", "group2_mean", "group1_sd", "group2_sd", "group1_median", "group2_median",
                     "group1_p25", "group2_p25", "group1_p75", "group2_p75",
                     "statistic", "estimate", "ci_lower", "ci_upper", "p_value", "smd", "smd_se", "effect_measure", "test", "note")
  existing_order <- desired_order[desired_order %in% names(out)]
  setcolorder(out, existing_order)
  return(out[])
}

# ---- Logging + safety wrappers -----------------------------------------------
table1_log <- data.table(
  project = character(), table_name = character(), cohort_name = character(),
  by_var = character(), table_type = character(), n_rows = integer(), n_groups = integer(),
  status = character(), reason = character(), output_file = character()
)

make_table1_safe <- function(dt, cat_vars, cont_vars, by, site_name, output_path, table_name, cohort_name, project = NA_character_) {
  if (is.null(dt) || nrow(dt) == 0) {
    table1_log <<- rbind(table1_log, data.table(project = project, table_name = table_name, cohort_name = cohort_name,
      by_var = by, table_type = "descriptive", n_rows = 0L, n_groups = 0L, status = "skipped_empty",
      reason = "Cohort has 0 rows", output_file = output_path), fill = TRUE)
    message("Skipping ", table_name, " table1: cohort is empty"); return(NULL)
  }
  if (!by %in% names(dt)) {
    table1_log <<- rbind(table1_log, data.table(project = project, table_name = table_name, cohort_name = cohort_name,
      by_var = by, table_type = "descriptive", n_rows = nrow(dt), n_groups = 0L, status = "failed",
      reason = paste0("by variable '", by, "' not in data"), output_file = output_path), fill = TRUE)
    message("Skipping ", table_name, " table1: by variable '", by, "' not in data"); return(NULL)
  }
  n_groups <- length(unique(dt[[by]][!is.na(dt[[by]])]))
  if (n_groups < 1) {
    table1_log <<- rbind(table1_log, data.table(project = project, table_name = table_name, cohort_name = cohort_name,
      by_var = by, table_type = "descriptive", n_rows = nrow(dt), n_groups = 0L, status = "skipped_empty",
      reason = paste0("by variable '", by, "' has no non-NA values"), output_file = output_path), fill = TRUE)
    message("Skipping ", table_name, " table1: by variable has no non-NA values"); return(NULL)
  }
  result <- tryCatch({
    tbl <- make_table1_federated(dt = dt, cat_vars = cat_vars, cont_vars = cont_vars, by = by, site_name = site_name)
    fwrite(tbl, output_path)
    table1_log <<- rbind(table1_log, data.table(project = project, table_name = table_name, cohort_name = cohort_name,
      by_var = by, table_type = "descriptive", n_rows = nrow(dt), n_groups = n_groups, status = "success",
      reason = NA_character_, output_file = output_path), fill = TRUE)
    tbl
  }, error = function(e) {
    table1_log <<- rbind(table1_log, data.table(project = project, table_name = table_name, cohort_name = cohort_name,
      by_var = by, table_type = "descriptive", n_rows = nrow(dt), n_groups = n_groups, status = "failed",
      reason = conditionMessage(e), output_file = output_path), fill = TRUE)
    message("Skipping ", table_name, " table1: ", conditionMessage(e)); return(NULL)
  })
  return(result)
}

make_table1_comparisons_safe <- function(dt, by, reference_level, cont_vars, cat_vars, site_name, output_path, table_name, cohort_name, project = NA_character_) {
  if (is.null(dt) || nrow(dt) == 0) {
    table1_log <<- rbind(table1_log, data.table(project = project, table_name = table_name, cohort_name = cohort_name,
      by_var = by, table_type = "comparisons", n_rows = 0L, n_groups = 0L, status = "skipped_empty",
      reason = "Cohort has 0 rows", output_file = output_path), fill = TRUE)
    message("Skipping ", table_name, " comparisons: cohort is empty"); return(NULL)
  }
  if (!by %in% names(dt)) {
    table1_log <<- rbind(table1_log, data.table(project = project, table_name = table_name, cohort_name = cohort_name,
      by_var = by, table_type = "comparisons", n_rows = nrow(dt), n_groups = 0L, status = "failed",
      reason = paste0("by variable '", by, "' not in data"), output_file = output_path), fill = TRUE)
    message("Skipping ", table_name, " comparisons: by variable '", by, "' not in data"); return(NULL)
  }
  observed_groups <- unique(as.character(dt[[by]])); observed_groups <- observed_groups[!is.na(observed_groups)]
  n_groups <- length(observed_groups)
  if (n_groups < 2) {
    table1_log <<- rbind(table1_log, data.table(project = project, table_name = table_name, cohort_name = cohort_name,
      by_var = by, table_type = "comparisons", n_rows = nrow(dt), n_groups = n_groups, status = "skipped_empty",
      reason = paste0("Only ", n_groups, " group(s) present; need >=2 for comparisons"), output_file = output_path), fill = TRUE)
    message("Skipping ", table_name, " comparisons: only ", n_groups, " group(s) in '", by, "'"); return(NULL)
  }
  if (!reference_level %in% observed_groups) {
    table1_log <<- rbind(table1_log, data.table(project = project, table_name = table_name, cohort_name = cohort_name,
      by_var = by, table_type = "comparisons", n_rows = nrow(dt), n_groups = n_groups, status = "skipped_empty",
      reason = paste0("Reference level '", reference_level, "' not present in data. Observed: ", paste(observed_groups, collapse = ", ")),
      output_file = output_path), fill = TRUE)
    message("Skipping ", table_name, " comparisons: reference level '", reference_level, "' not in data"); return(NULL)
  }
  result <- tryCatch({
    tbl <- make_table1_comparisons(dt = dt, by = by, reference_level = reference_level, cont_vars = cont_vars, cat_vars = cat_vars, site_name = site_name)
    fwrite(tbl, output_path)
    table1_log <<- rbind(table1_log, data.table(project = project, table_name = table_name, cohort_name = cohort_name,
      by_var = by, table_type = "comparisons", n_rows = nrow(dt), n_groups = n_groups, status = "success",
      reason = NA_character_, output_file = output_path), fill = TRUE)
    tbl
  }, error = function(e) {
    table1_log <<- rbind(table1_log, data.table(project = project, table_name = table_name, cohort_name = cohort_name,
      by_var = by, table_type = "comparisons", n_rows = nrow(dt), n_groups = n_groups, status = "failed",
      reason = conditionMessage(e), output_file = output_path), fill = TRUE)
    message("Skipping ", table_name, " comparisons: ", conditionMessage(e)); return(NULL)
  })
  return(result)
}

make_table1_pair <- function(dt, by, reference_level, cat_vars, cont_vars, site_name, tables_dir,
                             institution_prefix, cohort_name, file_stem, project = NA_character_) {
  desc_path <- file.path(tables_dir, paste0(institution_prefix, "_table1_", file_stem, "_descriptive.csv"))
  comp_path <- file.path(tables_dir, paste0(institution_prefix, "_table1_", file_stem, "_comparisons.csv"))
  desc <- make_table1_safe(dt = dt, cat_vars = cat_vars, cont_vars = cont_vars, by = by, site_name = site_name,
                           output_path = desc_path, table_name = paste0(file_stem, "_descriptive"),
                           cohort_name = cohort_name, project = project)
  comp <- make_table1_comparisons_safe(dt = dt, by = by, reference_level = reference_level, cont_vars = cont_vars,
                                       cat_vars = cat_vars, site_name = site_name, output_path = comp_path,
                                       table_name = paste0(file_stem, "_comparisons"), cohort_name = cohort_name, project = project)
  invisible(list(descriptive = desc, comparisons = comp))
}
```


# 4. DLMM shared specification and functions (identical at every site - do not edit)
```{r dlmm-spec}
#===============================================================================
# A. SHARED SPECIFICATION (do not edit at sites)
#===============================================================================
dlmm_spec_version <- "meas-dlmm-2026-11-16"   # bumped: continuous outcomes only

meas_outcomes_continuous <- c("vent_free_days_28_alt", "icu_free_days_28_alt", "hospital_free_days_28_alt")
# Binary outcomes (trach, in-hospital death, reintubation) are NOT federated: DLMM is exact only for linear models
# and the distributed GLMM is an approximation (Nick/Meeta, Nov 2026). Only the continuous outcomes are exported,
# so the complete-case sample is defined on these three outcomes alone.
sedation_measures <- c("percent_deep_sedation_48", "deep_sedation_count_total_48", "median_rass_cont",
                       "median_rass_binary", "rass_weighted_avg", "deep_sedation_weighted",
                       "sedation_index_score")
sedation_measure_labels <- c("Proportion of Time Deep Sedation (48hr)", "Total Hours Deep Sedation (48hr)",
                             "Median RASS (Continuous)", "Median RASS (Binary)", "Time-Weighted RASS (Continuous)",
                             "Time-Weighted RASS (Binary, <= -3)", "Sedation Index Score")

# Reference covariates (= the old measurements_covariates WITHOUT factor(hospital_icu_id); the ICU is the
# random-effect cluster, never a column of X). New-pipeline names.
meas_covariates <- c("lang_cat_1", "race_category", "age_category", "sex_category", "ethnicity_category_final", "bmi",
                     "elixhauser_score", "laps2", "intubation_site", "time_from_begin_obs_to_icu_hours",
                     "observation_year")

# Fixed level sets. The FIRST level is the reference. Every site gets exactly the same dummy columns even
# when a level is absent locally (that column is simply all zero at that site). Values not listed here stop
# the script with a message, because silently creating a new column would make the sites' matrices differ.
meas_factor_levels <- list(
  lang_cat_1               = c("english", "non-english"),
  race_category            = c("white", "black or african american", "other/unknown"),   # asian folded in below
  age_category             = c("18-34 Years", "35-49 Years", "50-64 Years", "65-74 Years", "75-84 Years", "85+ Years"),
  sex_category             = c("male", "female"),
  ethnicity_category_final = c("non-hispanic/unknown", "hispanic"),
  intubation_site          = c("icu", "ed", "or_procedural", "ward", "other", "unknown"),
  observation_year         = as.character(2012:2026)    # generous range; years with no data anywhere are dropped centrally
)
meas_min_icu_n <- 10   # Safety net only (ICUs are expected to have hundreds+ patients): an ICU below this is
                       # not exported, and the Penn validation applies the same rule so both fits use the same data.
meas_export_per_icu_crossproducts <- FALSE
# FALSE (recommended): per ICU only n_i, column sums of X and sum of y are exported; X'X, X'y, y'y are
#   exported once, summed over the site's ICUs. This is all the random-intercept likelihood uses
#   (see notes) and the fit is identical, but no within-ICU cross-classified counts leave the site.
# TRUE: per-ICU X_i'X_i, X_i'y_i, y_i'y_i, n_i exactly as in the implementation guide.

#===============================================================================
# B. Functions
#===============================================================================
meas_normalize <- function(x) gsub("_", " ", tolower(trimws(as.character(x))))

meas_prepare <- function(dt) {
  dt <- copy(as.data.table(dt))
  # new-pipeline names; old names accepted if a site still has them
  old_new <- c(imv_duration_hours_final = "run_hrs", reintubation_final = "reintubation",
               time_from_begin_imv_to_icu_hours = "time_from_begin_obs_to_icu_hours")
  for (o in names(old_new)) if (o %in% names(dt) && !old_new[[o]] %in% names(dt)) setnames(dt, o, old_new[[o]])

  # intubation_site (collapsed location of intubation) is built in the cohort pipeline; if an analytic file
  # lacks it, rebuild it from location_of_intubation_adj with the pipeline's exact rule
  if (!"intubation_site" %in% names(dt)) {
    loc_col <- intersect(c("location_of_intubation_adj", "location_of_intubation"), names(dt))[1]
    if (is.na(loc_col)) stop("Neither intubation_site nor location_of_intubation_adj is in the analytic file")
    loc <- tolower(trimws(as.character(dt[[loc_col]])))
    dt[, intubation_site := "other"]
    dt[loc %in% c("ward", "stepdown"), intubation_site := "ward"]
    dt[loc %in% "ed", intubation_site := "ed"]
    dt[loc %in% "icu", intubation_site := "icu"]
    dt[loc %in% "procedural", intubation_site := "or_procedural"]
    dt[is.na(loc), intubation_site := "unknown"]
    message("intubation_site rebuilt from ", loc_col)
  }
  dt[, race_category := meas_normalize(race_category)]
  dt[race_category %in% c("asian"), race_category := "other/unknown"]
  dt[race_category %in% c("black"), race_category := "black or african american"]
  for (v in c("sex_category", "ethnicity_category_final", "intubation_site"))
    set(dt, j = v, value = gsub(" ", "_", meas_normalize(dt[[v]])))           # "or procedural" -> "or_procedural"
  dt[, ethnicity_category_final := gsub("_", "-", ethnicity_category_final)]    # "non_hispanic/unknown" -> "non-hispanic/unknown"
  dt[, observation_year := as.character(as.integer(observation_year))]
  for (b in c("median_rass_binary", "deep_sedation_weighted"))
    if (b %in% names(dt)) set(dt, j = b, value = as.integer(as.logical(dt[[b]])))
  # English vs non-English (as in the old setup chunk); built here if the analytic file does not carry it
  if (!"lang_cat_1" %in% names(dt))
    dt[, lang_cat_1 := fifelse(meas_normalize(language_category) == "english", "english",
                               fifelse(!is.na(language_category), "non-english", NA_character_))]
  dt[, lang_cat_1 := gsub(" ", "-", meas_normalize(lang_cat_1))]                  # "non english" -> "non-english"
  dt
}

meas_check_levels <- function(dt) {
  bad <- rbindlist(lapply(names(meas_factor_levels), function(v) {
    x <- dt[[v]]; u <- setdiff(unique(x[!is.na(x)]), meas_factor_levels[[v]])
    if (length(u)) data.table(variable = v, unexpected_value = u, n = vapply(u, function(a) sum(x == a, na.rm = TRUE), 1L))
  }))
  if (nrow(bad)) { print(bad); stop("Values not in the shared level sets (section A). Recode them to an existing ",
                                    "level or report them to the coordinating site - do not add levels locally.") }
  for (v in names(meas_factor_levels)) set(dt, j = v, value = factor(dt[[v]], levels = meas_factor_levels[[v]]))
  invisible(dt)
}

meas_build_export <- function(cohort_dt, institution, min_icu_n = meas_min_icu_n,
                              per_icu_crossproducts = meas_export_per_icu_crossproducts) {
  outcomes <- meas_outcomes_continuous
  need <- c("hospital_icu_id", outcomes, meas_covariates, sedation_measures)
  miss <- setdiff(need, names(cohort_dt)); if (length(miss)) stop("Missing columns: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
  dt <- cohort_dt[, ..need]
  meas_check_levels(dt)

  # One complete-case sample for ALL outcomes and ALL eight models, so every model and every outcome uses the
  # same patients (needed for the LRT and for comparing R2 across definitions).
  n_start <- nrow(dt)
  na_by_var <- dt[, lapply(.SD, function(x) sum(is.na(x)))]
  na_by_var <- data.table(variable = names(na_by_var), n_missing = unlist(na_by_var))[n_missing > 0]
  na_by_var[, n_missing := ifelse(n_missing < 10, "<10", as.character(n_missing))]   # small-cell rule
  dt <- dt[complete.cases(dt)]
  n_complete <- nrow(dt)

  icu_n <- dt[, .N, by = hospital_icu_id]
  small <- icu_n[N < min_icu_n]
  dt <- dt[!hospital_icu_id %in% small$hospital_icu_id]
  if (!nrow(dt)) stop("No ICU has >= ", min_icu_n, " complete-case patients")

  # Design matrix: intercept + reference covariates + all 7 sedation measures (one X serves all 8 models)
  form_X <- reformulate(c(meas_covariates, sedation_measures))
  X <- model.matrix(form_X, data = model.frame(form_X, dt, na.action = na.fail))
  stopifnot(nrow(X) == nrow(dt), colnames(X)[1] == "(Intercept)", all(X[, 1] == 1))
  term_labels <- attr(terms(form_X), "term.labels")
  col_term <- c("(Intercept)", term_labels[attr(X, "assign")[-1]])

  # Anonymous ICU keys (the key file stays local)
  icu_ids <- sort(unique(as.character(dt$hospital_icu_id)))
  icu_key <- data.table(hospital_icu_id = icu_ids, icu_key = sprintf("%s_icu%02d", institution, seq_along(icu_ids)))
  grp <- icu_key$icu_key[match(as.character(dt$hospital_icu_id), icu_key$hospital_icu_id)]
  Y <- as.matrix(dt[, ..outcomes])

  per_icu <- lapply(icu_key$icu_key, function(k) {
    ix <- which(grp == k); Xi <- X[ix, , drop = FALSE]; Yi <- Y[ix, , drop = FALSE]
    out <- list(icu_key = k, n = length(ix), col_sums = colSums(Xi), y_sums = colSums(Yi))
    if (per_icu_crossproducts) out <- c(out, list(S_X = crossprod(Xi), S_Xy = crossprod(Xi, Yi), s_y = colSums(Yi^2)))
    out
  })
  names(per_icu) <- icu_key$icu_key

  export <- list(
    spec_version = dlmm_spec_version, institution = institution, created = format(Sys.time(), tz = "UTC"),
    per_icu_crossproducts = per_icu_crossproducts,
    colnames_X = colnames(X), col_term = col_term, covariates = meas_covariates,
    sedation_measures = sedation_measures, factor_levels = meas_factor_levels,
    outcomes = outcomes,
    n_total = nrow(X), n_icus = length(per_icu), min_icu_n = min_icu_n,
    site_S_X = crossprod(X), site_S_Xy = crossprod(X, Y), site_s_y = colSums(Y^2),   # summed over the site's ICUs
    per_icu = per_icu,
    flow = data.table(step = c("measurements cohort", "complete cases (outcomes, covariates, measures)",
                                paste0("in ICUs with >= ", min_icu_n, " patients")),
                      n = c(n_start, n_complete, nrow(X)), n_icus = c(uniqueN(cohort_dt$hospital_icu_id),
                                                                      nrow(icu_n), length(per_icu))),
    missing_by_variable = na_by_var)
  list(export = export, icu_key = icu_key, X = X, data = dt)
}


# Measurements cohort (old Step 1): IMV >= 24 h, not a neuro ICU, no continuous or push NMBA in 48 h
meas_make_cohort <- function(total_cohort) {
  d <- meas_prepare(total_cohort)
  d[run_hrs >= 24 &
    !icu_imv %in% c("mixed_neuro_icu", "neuro_icu", "neurosurgical_icu") &
    !(continuous_nmba_48 %in% 1 | push_paralytics %in% 1)]   # exclude only KNOWN NMBA (Part Ten fills "none" as 0)
}
```

# 5. Define the measurements cohort
```{r cohort}
# Same three steps as the May 2026 code, with new-pipeline names. meas_prepare() standardizes names and
# category spellings (and builds lang_cat_1) without dropping anyone.
neuro_icus <- c("mixed_neuro_icu", "neuro_icu", "neurosurgical_icu")
mc_0 <- meas_prepare(total_cohort)

measurements_project_cohort_24       <- mc_0[run_hrs >= 24]                                   # Step 1
measurements_project_cohort_no_neuro <- measurements_project_cohort_24[!icu_imv %in% neuro_icus]   # Step 2
measurements_project_cohort          <- measurements_project_cohort_no_neuro[                 # Step 3
  !(continuous_nmba_48 %in% 1 | push_paralytics %in% 1)]  # exclude only patients with a KNOWN push or infusion

# Part Ten sets both flags to 0 when no paralytic is charted, so NA should not occur. An NA means the patient was
# missing from the meds summary (a pipeline mismatch between Parts Ten and Twelve) - kept here, but flagged.
n_nmba_missing <- measurements_project_cohort_no_neuro[is.na(continuous_nmba_48) | is.na(push_paralytics), .N]
if (n_nmba_missing > 0) warning(n_nmba_missing, " patients have missing NMBA flags (kept in the cohort). ",
                                "Check that Part Ten's meds summary covers the whole cohort.")

# Must be the same cohort meas_make_cohort() (used by the coordinating site's validation) produces
stopifnot(setequal(measurements_project_cohort$hospitalization_id, meas_make_cohort(total_cohort)$hospitalization_id),
          !anyDuplicated(measurements_project_cohort$hospitalization_id))
cat("Measurements cohort:", nrow(measurements_project_cohort), "patients in",
    uniqueN(measurements_project_cohort$hospital_icu_id), "ICUs\n")
```

# 6. Table 1 (by ICU type) and missingness
```{r table1}
# R&R: hospital_id removed - hospital names identify the health system and small hospitals create cells of <10
cat_vars <- intersect(c("sex_category", "ethnicity_category_final", "race_category", "lang_cat_1",
                        "intubation_site", "admission_type_category", "observation_year"),
                      names(measurements_project_cohort))
cont_vars <- intersect(c("age_at_admission", "bmi", "elixhauser_score", "SVM_SCORE", "laps2", "time_to_first_rass",
                         "rass_frequency_hrs", "time_from_begin_obs_to_icu_hours", "run_hrs"),
                       names(measurements_project_cohort))
# Comparison reference = medical ICU, or the most common ICU type at sites without one
icu_types <- measurements_project_cohort[, .N, by = icu_imv][order(-N)]

  dt = measurements_project_cohort, by = "icu_imv", reference_level = icu_ref,

# Missingness of every variable the DLMM model uses (counts only; no patient identifiers leave the site)
model_vars <- c(meas_outcomes_continuous, meas_covariates, sedation_measures, "hospital_icu_id")

  site = institution, variable = model_vars,
```

# 8. Site-level models: all six outcomes (reported per site; NOT federated or meta-analyzed)
```{r site-models}
# For each outcome: a reference model (covariates only) and one candidate model per sedation measure (reference +
# that measure), fitted to the SAME patients (complete cases for that outcome), so the comparisons are valid.
#   PRIMARY     : random intercept for ICU   - lmer (continuous) / glmer (binary); Nakagawa marginal & conditional R2
#   SENSITIVITY : fixed effect for ICU       - lm (continuous) / glm (binary); R2 / McFadden pseudo-R2
# Candidate vs reference: LRT (mixed models and glm) or F-test (lm).
# Only the three continuous outcomes are also federated (section 7); the binary ones are site-level only.
meas_site_outcomes <- list(
  list(outcome = "vent_free_days_28_alt",     binary = FALSE, short = "28dvfd",       stub = "vfd_models_rsquared_table"),
  list(outcome = "icu_free_days_28_alt",      binary = FALSE, short = "28dicufd",     stub = "icufd_models_rsquared_table"),
  list(outcome = "hospital_free_days_28_alt", binary = FALSE, short = "28dhfd",       stub = "hfd_models_rsquared_table"),
  list(outcome = "trached",                   binary = TRUE,  short = "trach",        stub = "trach_models_rsquared_table"),
  list(outcome = "death_during_admission",    binary = TRUE,  short = "mortality",    stub = "mortality_models_rsquared_table"),
  list(outcome = "reintubation",              binary = TRUE,  short = "reintubation", stub = "reintubation_models_rsquared_table"))

# Same covariates and category handling as the DLMM export; unused levels are dropped for these site-level fits
meas_site_data <- copy(measurements_project_cohort)
meas_check_levels(meas_site_data)
meas_site_data[, hospital_icu_id := factor(as.character(hospital_icu_id))]

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
coef_table <- function(fit) {                         # term / estimate / SE / statistic / p for any of the 4 model types
  ct <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  p <- if (ncol(ct) >= 4) ct[, 4] else 2 * pnorm(-abs(ct[, 3]))   # lmer has no p column: Wald (normal) p
  data.table(term = rownames(ct), estimate = ct[, 1], std.error = ct[, 2], statistic = ct[, 3], p.value = p)
}
mcfadden <- function(fit) {                           # McFadden pseudo-R2 = 1 - logLik(model) / logLik(intercept-only)
  null <- glm(fit$y ~ 1, family = binomial())
  1 - as.numeric(logLik(fit)) / as.numeric(logLik(null))
}
r2_nak <- function(fit) tryCatch({
  r <- suppressWarnings(performance::r2_nakagawa(fit))
  c(marginal = unname(r$R2_marginal), conditional = unname(r$R2_conditional))
}, error = function(e) { message("r2_nakagawa failed: ", conditionMessage(e)); c(marginal = NA_real_, conditional = NA_real_) })

fit_site_model <- function(d, outcome, measure, binary, mixed, model_name) {
  rhs <- c(measure, meas_covariates, if (mixed) "(1 | hospital_icu_id)" else "factor(hospital_icu_id)")
  f <- reformulate(rhs, outcome)
  msgs <- character(0)
  fit <- tryCatch(withCallingHandlers({
    if (mixed && !binary) lme4::lmer(f, data = d, REML = FALSE)        # ML so the LRT across fixed effects is valid
    else if (mixed &&  binary) lme4::glmer(f, data = d, family = binomial(),
                                           control = lme4::glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)))
    else if (!binary) lm(f, data = d)
    else glm(f, data = d, family = binomial())
  }, warning = function(w) { msgs <<- c(msgs, conditionMessage(w)); invokeRestart("muffleWarning") },
     message = function(m) { msgs <<- c(msgs, conditionMessage(m)); invokeRestart("muffleMessage") }),
  error = function(e) { message(model_name, " failed: ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
  if (!is.null(fit) && length(msgs)) {
    message(model_name, ": ", paste(unique(msgs), collapse = " | "))
    attr(fit, "fit_warnings") <- paste(unique(msgs), collapse = " | ")
  }
  fit
}

compare_models <- function(ref, cand, mixed, binary) {
  a <- tryCatch(suppressMessages(if (!mixed && binary) anova(ref, cand, test = "LRT") else anova(ref, cand)),
                error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(a)) return(c(stat = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
  sc <- intersect(c("Chisq", "Deviance", "F"), names(a))[1]
  pc <- intersect(c("Pr(>Chisq)", "Pr(>Chi)", "Pr(Chi)", "Pr(>F)", "Pr(F)"), names(a))[1]
  c(stat = if (!is.na(sc)) a[[sc]][2] else NA_real_, p = if (!is.na(pc)) a[[pc]][2] else NA_real_)
}

meas_model_log <- list()
for (spec in meas_site_outcomes) {
  if (!spec$outcome %in% names(meas_site_data)) { message("Skipping ", spec$outcome, ": not in the analytic file"); next }
  d <- meas_site_data[complete.cases(meas_site_data[, c(spec$outcome, meas_covariates, sedation_measures, "hospital_icu_id"), with = FALSE])]
  if (spec$binary) d[, (spec$outcome) := as.integer(as.logical(get(spec$outcome)))]
  # Same ICU rule as the DLMM export, so the continuous site-level models use exactly the exported patients
  d <- d[hospital_icu_id %in% d[, .N, by = hospital_icu_id][N >= meas_min_icu_n, hospital_icu_id]]
  for (v in meas_covariates) if (is.factor(d[[v]])) set(d, j = v, value = droplevels(d[[v]]))
  d[, hospital_icu_id := droplevels(hospital_icu_id)]
  # glmer only: continuous COVARIATES are standardized (mean 0, SD 1) - their raw scales (e.g. LAPS2 in the
  # hundreds) make glmer fail to converge. This does not change R2 or the LRT; the sedation measure stays raw.
  d_glmer <- copy(d)
  for (v in c("bmi", "elixhauser_score", "laps2", "time_from_begin_obs_to_icu_hours"))
    if (v %in% names(d_glmer)) set(d_glmer, j = v, value = as.numeric(scale(d_glmer[[v]])))

  for (mixed in c(TRUE, FALSE)) {
    suffix <- if (mixed) "" else "_fixed"
    tag <- paste0(spec$short, suffix)
    if (mixed && uniqueN(d$hospital_icu_id) < 3) {
      message(tag, ": fewer than 3 ICUs - random intercept not estimable, skipped"); next }
    d_fit <- if (mixed && spec$binary) d_glmer else d
    ref <- fit_site_model(d_fit, spec$outcome, NULL, spec$binary, mixed, paste0("reference_model_", tag))
    if (is.null(ref)) next
    r2_of <- function(fit) if (mixed) r2_nak(fit) else
      c(marginal = if (spec$binary) mcfadden(fit) else summary(fit)$r.squared, conditional = NA_real_)
    ref_r2 <- r2_of(ref)
    fwrite(rbind(coef_table(ref), data.table(term = c("R2_marginal_or_R2", "R2_conditional"), estimate = ref_r2), fill = TRUE),
           file.path(measurements_model_data, paste0(institution, "_reference_model_", tag, ".csv")))

    res_rows <- lapply(seq_along(sedation_measures), function(i) {
      m <- sedation_measures[i]
      cand <- fit_site_model(d_fit, spec$outcome, m, spec$binary, mixed, paste0(tag, "_model_", i, "_", m))
      if (is.null(cand)) return(data.table(model = sedation_measure_labels[i]))
      r2 <- r2_of(cand); cmp <- compare_models(ref, cand, mixed, spec$binary)
      fwrite(rbind(coef_table(cand), data.table(term = c("R2_marginal_or_R2", "R2_conditional"), estimate = r2), fill = TRUE),
             file.path(measurements_model_data, paste0(institution, "_", tag, "_", i, ".csv")))
      data.table(model = sedation_measure_labels[i], r2_marginal = r2[["marginal"]], r2_conditional = r2[["conditional"]],
                 test_statistic = cmp[["stat"]], test_p_value = cmp[["p"]],
                 singular_fit = if (mixed) lme4::isSingular(cand) else NA,
                 fit_warnings = attr(cand, "fit_warnings") %||% NA_character_)
    })
    summary_dt <- rbindlist(c(res_rows, list(data.table(model = "Reference Model", r2_marginal = ref_r2[["marginal"]],
                                                        r2_conditional = ref_r2[["conditional"]],
                                                        singular_fit = if (mixed) lme4::isSingular(ref) else NA,
                                                        fit_warnings = attr(ref, "fit_warnings") %||% NA_character_))), fill = TRUE)
    summary_dt[, `:=`(outcome = spec$outcome, n = nrow(d), n_icus = uniqueN(d$hospital_icu_id),
                      r2_type = if (mixed) "Nakagawa marginal / conditional" else if (spec$binary) "McFadden pseudo-R2" else "R2",
                      test_type = if (mixed || spec$binary) "LRT" else "F-test",
                      model_type = if (mixed) "mixed (random intercept for ICU)" else "fixed effect for ICU",
                      covariates_standardized = mixed && spec$binary,
                      institution = institution)]
    if (spec$binary) summary_dt[, n_events := sum(d[[spec$outcome]])]
    print(summary_dt[, .(model, r2_marginal, r2_conditional, test_p_value)])
    fwrite(summary_dt, file.path(measurements_final_data, paste0(institution, "_", spec$stub, suffix, ".csv")))
    meas_model_log[[tag]] <- data.table(outcome = spec$outcome, analysis = tag, n = nrow(d), n_icus = uniqueN(d$hospital_icu_id))
  }
}
meas_model_log <- rbindlist(meas_model_log)
```
